abdominal_crunch.name: Abdominal Crunch
abdominal_crunch.notes: Curl your ribcage toward your pelvis, then return under control. Do not let the stack drop.

arnold_press.name: Arnold Press
arnold_press.notes: Find comfortable grip or you will hurt your hands! Rotation is passive, not forced. Stop before lower back takes over.

back_ext.name: Back Extension Machine
back_ext.notes: Bend and extend through your hips, not your lower back. Stop when your body is straight. Control the return.

barbell_curl.name: Barbell Curl
barbell_curl.notes: Keep elbows still and tucked. A small body swing is OK only on your final difficult reps.

chest_press_machine.name: Chest Press Machine
chest_press_machine.notes: Press smoothly with both arms together. Keep shoulders down and back. Control the return.

db_bench.name: Dumbbell Flat Bench Press
db_bench.notes: Lower slow. Press straight up. Do not bounce or rush the bottom.

db_bench_incline.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
db_bench_incline.notes: Please find a comfortable grip or you will hurt yourself! Set bench to Notch 2 (30°) or Notch 1 (15°/20°) to isolate the upper chest. Plant feet. Rotate dumbbells slightly inward (10°-15° maximum)

db_shrug.name: Dumbbell Shrug
db_shrug.notes: Shrug straight up. Pause briefly. Don't roll your shoulders.

db_wrist_curl.name: Wrist Curl
db_wrist_curl.notes: Brace forearms on thighs or bench. Curl wrists upward through full range. Lower slowly under control.

glute_kickback.name: Glute Kickback Machine
glute_kickback.notes: Push back with heel. Keep hips still. Squeeze at the top.

hammer_curl.name: Hammer Curl
hammer_curl.notes: Keep a neutral grip throughout. Tilt the dumbbells slightly inward toward your shoulders. Curl smoothly and lower under control.

lat_pull.name: Lat Pulldown
lat_pull.notes: Pull down to chest. Keep body still. Pull elbows down toward your sides. Keep chest up and avoid swinging.

db_lat_raise.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
db_lat_raise.notes: Raise out to the sides. Slight elbow bend stays the same. No swinging, Slow eccentric.

lateral_raise_machine.name: Seated Lateral Raise Machine
lateral_raise_machine.notes: Lower seat height. Stop at shoulder height, no shrugging. Stop before your shoulders shrug or your wrists bend excessively.

leg_curl.name: Seated Leg Curl
leg_curl.notes: Control the return. Do not shorten the range. Curl as far as you comfortably can.

leg_press.name: Leg Press
leg_press.notes: Control depth. Keep knees pointed in the same direction as your toes. Lower under control to a comfortable depth. Adjust seat depth.

db_ohp.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
db_ohp.notes: Press straight up. Keep body tight. Do not lean back. Lock out at top.

rdl_db.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
rdl_db.notes: Hinge at hips, soft knee, lower until hamstring stretch, drive hips forward to return.

reverse_curl.name: Reverse Curl
reverse_curl.notes: Keep elbows still. Curl the weight soothly without letting your shoulders take over. Use a curled EZ bar.

reverse_pd.name: Reverse Peck Deck
reverse_pd.notes: Do not use momentum. Thumbless grip.

row_dumbbell.name: Supported Single-Arm Row
row_dumbbell.notes: Pull to your side. Keep body still. Do not twist. Row to hip, not shoulder.

row_machine.name: Seated Row Machine
row_machine.notes: Pause 1 second when the handle reaches your body. Pull elbows back, keep chest against the pad, and sit tall.

shoulder_press_machine.name: Shoulder Press Machine
shoulder_press_machine.notes: Adjust seat depth and use narrow grip. Keep elbows slightly forward, avoid shrugging, and control the return.

skull_crushers.name: Skull Crushers
skull_crushers.notes: Bend and extend elbows only. Keep upper arms still. Lower to forehead/crown, full extension up.

tri_press.name: Triceps Press Machine
tri_press.notes: Push down and lock out. Keep elbows still. Raise the seat height if needed.
